classification.difficultyReason: Converts a pictograph with half symbols (3.5×4) and reads a column graph with a scale of 2 per gridline, then subtracts.

content.prompt: How many more Year 7 students than Year 8 students chose netball as their favourite sport?

answer.worked:
For netball:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Year 7 students}&=3.5\times4\\&=14\\\text{Year 8 students}&=10\\\text{Difference}&=14-10\\&=4\end{align*}$$
There are $4$ more Year 7 students.
